signals.title: “You’re not scattered, you’re multidimensional”: ilovecreatives on owning your ‘slashiness’
signals.description: Class is in session! Founder of ilovecreatives (the digital trade school and branding and design studio) Jennifer Puno walks us through the ins and outs of her squiggly career to date – no details missed out. The designer, content creator and ‘edutainer’ worked out early in her career that picking one thing and doing it for the rest of her life wasn’t going to work out, so she learnt how to build a career around multiple identities and interests. Here, she argues that focusing all your attention on figuring out your ‘thing’, might not lead you on the right path after all.
